candidateAudit.title: Austria 2023. A little countryside, a whole lot of city, Matty’s 16th birthday, and one of our favorite family adventures. ❤️ First stop, Salzburg. Oh, that countryside! So green,
candidateAudit.text: Austria 2023. A little countryside, a whole lot of city, Matty’s 16th birthday, and one of our favorite family adventures. ❤️ First stop, Salzburg. Oh, that countryside! So green, lush and beautifully kept, I swear even the cows were smiling. 😂. Still my favorite countryside we’ve visited. The salt mines were a highlight! We straddled the Austria–Germany border, up in the mountains and down in the mines. And the gardens and mountains from The Sound of Music? 🥹 The little girl in me who sang along with Maria through a million reruns was SO happy. Then Vienna! 😍 Gorgeous architecture, elegant streets, luxury shops. Like walking through a magazine. We stayed at the Park Hyatt Vienna, and that’s where my love affair with Park Hyatt began. Our room was majestic, so fitting for the city, and the service was top tier. We celebrated Matty’s sweet 16 there, too. ❤️ Now let me brag about my husband a little. Okay, a LOT. 😂 This trip was worth $60K. SIXTY THOUSAND DOLLARS. And every flight and hotel stay was booked on POINTS! Business class flights TWICE, The Ritz-Carlton, Tysons Corner on our way to Europe, and the magnificent Park Hyatt Vienna! My husband planned and coordinated it all through Pique Season Travel. This man is a points master! Collecting points is one thing. Knowing how to turn them into experiences like THIS? That’s a whole different skill. Luxury travel without paying luxury cash prices for flights and hotels. And the best part? Experiencing it all together while our kids are still growing up. These are the memories we’ll carry forever. The trip was worth $60K. The memories? Absolutely priceless. ❤️ And yes, I’m keeping my points master around. He’s got more places to take us. 😂✈️ #PiqueSeasonTravel #Austria #Salzburg #Vienna #FamilyTravel

candidateAudit.text: 🎉 GEWINNSPIEL: BITEVA GRILLBOX! 🔥 Gemeinsam mit biteva.at verlosen wir 3 × 1 Grillbox inklusive Mini-Grill an drei glückliche Gewinner:innen! 🥩🔥 So machst du mit: • Folge tastytrails.vienna & biteva.at • Like diesen Beitrag ❤️ • Markiere die Person in den Kommentaren, mit der du gemeinsam grillen möchtest. 📅 Teilnahmeschluss: 24.10.2026, 0:00 Uhr Die drei Gewinner:innen werden anschließend zufällig ausgelost und ausschließlich von tastytrails.vienna per Direktnachricht verständigt. ⚠️ Dieses Gewinnspiel steht in keiner Verbindung zu Instagram. Der Rechtsweg ist ausgeschlossen. Der Gewinn kann nicht in bar abgelöst oder übertragen werden. Bitte reagiert ausschließlich auf Nachrichten unseres offiziellen Accounts. BITEVA ist ein neues Wiener Food-Konzept und liefert euch eine komplette Grillbox direkt nach Hause – je nach Verfügbarkeit sogar noch am selben Tag. In der Box stecken ein Mini-Grill mit Instant-Kohle, bereits mariniertes Fleisch, Salat, Beilagen und Saucen. 👀 Wir haben alle vier Grillboxen getestet: 🌭 Rinds-Käsekrainer-Box – ca. 33,90 € Rinds-Käsekrainer mit Hotdog-Brötchen und Röstzwiebeln – damit baut ihr euch direkt am Grill euren eigenen Hotdog. Unser Favorit! 🔥 🍗 Hühnerbrust-Box – ca. 29,90 € Bereits marinierte Hühnerbrust zum direkten Grillen. 🥩 Rinderhals-Box – ca. 34,90 € Marinierter Rinderhals für den Mini-Grill. 🥩 Rib-Eye-Box – ca. 40,90 € Rib Eye zum Selbergrillen – die teuerste der vier Varianten. Die Fleischqualität hat uns bei allen vier überzeugt – und auch der kleine Grill funktioniert: anzünden, Fleisch drauf und kurz darauf brutzelt’s. 🔥 💧 Am Ende könnt ihr die Kohle einfach mit dem mitgelieferten Wasser löschen. ➕ Folgt uns für außergewöhnliche Food-Konzepte, Neueröffnungen und Food-Erlebnisse in Wien! #tastytrails #biteva #gril

candidateAudit.title: Prvi balkanski Oktoberfest u Beču 🍻 Sa svakom kartom koju ste kupili mogli ste se slobodno kretati kroz sve prostore i obje bine. Stajaća mjesta su bila po principu ko prije dođe,
candidateAudit.text: Prvi balkanski Oktoberfest u Beču 🍻 Sa svakom kartom koju ste kupili mogli ste se slobodno kretati kroz sve prostore i obje bine. Stajaća mjesta su bila po principu ko prije dođe, njegovo mjesto, a oni koji su uzeli sto imali su svoj zagarantovan sto. Mi smo imali stajaće karte, ali smo se slobodno kretali i hvatali po dio atmosfere sa svake bine. Što kaže moj tata: Nijedna žurka i nijedno veselje ne može biti loše, jer se veselimo. Tako da ni ovaj put nije bilo loše. A kad kažem da nije bilo loše, mislim da smo ostali skoro do kraja. Stvarno smo uživali i bilo nam je lijepo. Otišli smo skeptični, ali što se tiče organizacije, meni je bilo super. Za organizaciju su bili zaduženi (po mojim izvorima): beertija.pub balkan.oktoberfest kleinenachtmusik 6arevents idem_fm.at Ako nešto nisam navela kako treba, ispravite me u komentaru. 🙏 Ovo je bilo čak više iznenađujuće dobro nego što sam očekivala. A vi, ko je bio? Napišite mi kakvi su vam utisci. 👇 #balkanoktoberfest #oktoberfestwien #wien #vienna #wienevents canamitrovic_official sejo_kalac22 il_mondo_band kleinenachtmusik

candidateAudit.text: A little bit of summer to preserve. 🌶️ Even in mid-October, you can still find a few last summer favourites at the market — colourful peppers, chillies and all those flavours worth holding on to a little longer. Fresh chillies are wonderful as they are, but roasting them with garlic and sweet peppers brings out a whole new depth of flavour. Blended into a sauce and preserved in jars, they bring a little warmth back to the kitchen long after summer has faded. Vienna’s markets are full of seasonal inspiration — sometimes for a traditional dish, sometimes for something entirely your own. What would you make with a batch of homemade chilli sauce? 🌶️ #ViennaMarkets #SeasonalCooking #Preserving #ChilliSauce #ViennaFood

candidateAudit.title: 🛍️ My Go-To Buys at Keplerplatz Market, Vienna 🇦🇹 If you love discovering local markets in Vienna, here are 3 things I always buy at Keplerplatz Market! 🥰 🥩 1. Fresh Meat from
candidateAudit.text: 🛍️ My Go-To Buys at Keplerplatz Market, Vienna 🇦🇹 If you love discovering local markets in Vienna, here are 3 things I always buy at Keplerplatz Market! 🥰 🥩 1. Fresh Meat from Mekka Halal Fleisch My go-to choices are Cevapcici, burger patties and lamb chops from Hala Fleisch. What I appreciate most is how clean and well-organised the meat counter looks, without piles of meat stacked up. The meat also seems to have less excess blood, which I find makes preparation easier and helps reduce strong smells when cooking. Perfect for a delicious homemade meal! 🍖 🥬 2. Seasonal Fruits & Vegetables at Great Prices One of my favourite things about this market is the fresh, colourful seasonal products! 🍅🥒🍎 The vegetables look so vibrant and tempting, and the prices are often great, too. It's the kind of place where you go for a few things and end up bringing home a whole bag of fresh ingredients! 🍗 3. Roast Chicken & Roast Beef from Radatz Sometimes, I pick up some roast chicken or roast beef from Radatz. It's my little shortcut for a delicious Saturday lunch without spending hours in the kitchen. 😋 Add some fresh market vegetables, and a simple, satisfying weekend lunch is ready! ❤️ ✨ My little tip: If you're exploring Vienna's local food markets, add Keplerplatz to your list.
